memoryBuilder.verseText: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

sequence.prompt: Jesus taught us how to pray. What do we do? Put it in order.

items.label: Talk to God like a loving Father
Ask for God's Kingdom to come
Ask God for what we need
Ask for forgiveness and forgive others

matches.prompt: Match each part of prayer to what it means.

pairs.right: God loves us like a perfect father
God gives us a fresh start

application.question: Jesus wants to hear from you! What do you most want to tell God right now?
application.followUp: God loves to hear from you — any time, any place, about anything. You can always talk to Him. He always listens.
